observations: The filtered control-plane dataset now has provider-level labels for all 28 strategy benchmark frames.
Fourteen frames have at least one known provider-mate option and fourteen have only max_plies-labeled provider proposals.
Raw score, normalized score, provider-local rank, and stage-prior heuristics recover many converting providers when one is present.
Simple visible context heuristic remains weak because context terms alone do not map cleanly to provider ownership.
Stage 7 remains a held-out challenge set, not a local repair target.

candidate_outputs: explanation of source terms and proposals

minimum_before_implementation: Architecture review explicitly authorizes a default-off sandbox implementation.
Provider-label semantics are documented for selected-vs-forced labels.
Positive-provider and max-only frames are separated in evaluation.
Stage 7 challenge cases remain held out from sandbox tuning.
The arbiter can explain every recommendation through visible terms and proposal metadata.
A default-off equivalence test plan exists before any runtime code is added.
Guardrails are listed before any candidate can move beyond sandbox.

future_evaluation_protocol.phase_2: tiny default-off/on sandbox smoke only if explicitly approved
future_evaluation_protocol.phase_4: protected Stage 6/5/4/1 guardrails only if target improves
future_evaluation_protocol.phase_5: M1-M4 preservation suite before any promotion discussion

guardrails: Stage 1 backchain / KRK entry if cheap
KPK->KQK bridge sanity if the arbiter generalizes beyond KRK

open_risks.detail: Some labels are selected-provider outcomes while others are forced-provider outcomes; a future arbiter must keep these separated.
Half the current benchmark frames have no known converting provider proposal; this may indicate continuation capacity, missing proposals, or labeling limits.
Terminal-space context alone is insufficient; proposal-relative features and monitor evidence are likely required.
Stage 7 residuals must remain challenge cases rather than the sole optimization target.
